items.headline: Bitquery revises CryptoBilis theft estimate to US$102.0m
items.what_happened: In its 12 October update, Bitquery raises its estimate to US$102.0m across 324 wallets after identifying nine additional TRON wallets drained on 9 October.
items.why_it_matters: Bitquery also retracts its Binance-linked tracing lead: the intermediary wallets were THORChain vaults and those Binance payments belonged to other users.
items.risk: These are the investigator’s estimates. Chain tracing does not establish how all keys were exposed; the findings do not establish a compromise of all Ledger devices or services.

items.headline: ALLOX announces its public sale is open; token launch date is unconfirmed
items.what_happened: AlloX’s public announcement says its US$1m sale window closes on 19 October at 12:00 UTC. The token generation event will occur separately and has no confirmed date.
items.why_it_matters: Saved launch research now retains the sale deadline and differing price and vesting plans. This remains a watch-only lead, with no approved entry setup.
items.risk: KYC/KYB and jurisdiction restrictions apply; Australian eligibility is unverified. Sale infrastructure is not an exchange listing, and commitments are irrevocable.
